ACUS01 KWNS 240104
SWODY1
SPC AC 240102

Day 1 Convective Outlook  
NWS Storm Prediction Center Norman OK
0802 PM CDT Fri Oct 23 2026

Valid 240100Z - 241200Z

...THERE IS A MARGINAL RISK OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS OVER PORTIONS OF
NEW MEXICO...SOUTHERN COLORADO AND FAR WEST TEXAS...

...SUMMARY...
Isolated severe thunderstorms with large hail, severe gusts, and
perhaps a tornado remain possible across portions of New Mexico,
southern Colorado, and Far West Texas this evening.

...New Mexico and Far West Texas...
Evening satellite imagery showed a broad upper trough over the Great
Basin and western US with a basal shortwave feature approaching the
Desert Southwest from northern Baja. Modest low-level moisture has
been advected northward ahead of these features supporting
destabilization over much of NM and Far West TX. This has resulted
in scattered thunderstorms from northern Mexico to southern CO this
afternoon and evening. Enhanced southerly mid-level flow of 40-50
kts has aided in organizing the storms into a mix of into supercells
and clusters with hail and severe gusts as the primary risk.

While sufficient for severe storms, the general environment is
expected to become less conducive through the remainder of this
evening with gradually decreasing buoyancy and favorable deep-layer
shear for organized storms. The onset of nocturnal cooling and
storms moving into a drier/more deeply mixed air mass farther east
across NM and Far West TX suggest the severe threat for severe gusts
and hail will become increasingly more isolated and focused tonight.

..Lyons.. 10/24/2026
